limitations: The action is defined only on an open static spacelike branch and is not a global cosmological completion.
The exact spherical motion derivation assumes weak-field isolated dust and does not solve an extended nonspherical system.
Universal conformal coupling supplies no independent photon adjustment; quantitative lensing still requires the unsolved Einstein-scalar boundary-value problem.
Positive local energy and NEC combinations do not repair the scalar cone, transition degeneracy, or finite-gradient endpoint.

symbolic_checks.statement: The branch kinetic density differentiates to -s^2/(1-2s).
The branch coordinate obeys ds/dXbar=-alpha^2/s.
The action gives the frozen minimal kinetic coefficient.
The longitudinal coefficient is positive on the open branch.
The branch inverse relation is x=s^2/(1-2s).
The integrated scalar flux exactly matches alpha times g_N.
The positive total acceleration branch is y=sqrt(x^2+x).
The scalar radial cone ratio exceeds two on 0<s<1/2.
The static scalar energy density is -p in frozen units.
The radial pressure includes the scalar-gradient anisotropy.
The two tangential pressures equal p.
The static pressure anisotropy is positive on the open branch.
The radial null-energy combination is positive.
The tangential null-energy combination is saturated.
The low-gradient energy density scales as s^3/3.
The kinetic coefficient vanishes at the low-gradient boundary.
The longitudinal coefficient vanishes at the low-gradient boundary.
The scalar radial cone ratio tends to two, not one.
The high-source limit reaches a finite scalar-gradient endpoint.
The inverse kinetic coefficient vanishes at the endpoint.
The inverse longitudinal coefficient vanishes at the endpoint.
The inverse energy density vanishes at the endpoint.
The direct conformal scalar shifts cancel from Phi+Psi.
A positive conformal factor preserves every Einstein-frame null direction.

obstruction_contract.global_domain: The action has neither a healthy Xbar=0 crossing nor a real timelike cosmological branch nor a regular continuation through the finite-gradient endpoint.
obstruction_contract.high_source_endpoint: As s->1/2, Xbar approaches the finite value -1/(8 alpha^2) while p->-infinity and p_Xbar,K->infinity.
obstruction_contract.interpretation: The restricted action is an exact motion-law embedding and a same-action lensing architecture, not a viable completed gravity theory.
obstruction_contract.low_gradient: As s->0, p~-s^3/3 and both p_Xbar and K vanish; the exact deep-AQUAL transition is degenerate.
obstruction_contract.scalar_cone: K/p_Xbar=2(1-s)/(1-2s)>2 everywhere on the open branch and diverges as s->1/2.

restricted_action_contract.einstein_frame_action: S=integral sqrt(-g)[Mpl^2 R/2 + 2 Mpl^2 a0^2 p(Xbar)] + S_m[exp(2 alpha phi/Mpl) g,psi]

restricted_action_contract.scope_limit: This is a real covariant density only on the declared spacelike branch; no timelike or endpoint continuation is supplied.

spherical_motion_contract.assumptions: static weak-field flat-spatial spherical dust, regular center, isolated source, phi_prime>0, and the same enclosed baryonic mass defines g_N
spherical_motion_contract.no_fit_statement: The action normalization is fixed algebraically from the frozen formula map; no observational row, coefficient fit, or post-outcome repair is used.

stress_and_lensing_contract.direct_conformal_lensing: Phi_tilde+Psi_tilde=Phi_E+Psi_E; the direct conformal scalar shift cancels from leading lensing.
stress_and_lensing_contract.energy_observation: p decreases from zero on 0<s<1/2, so rho_phi>0; radial NEC is positive and tangential NEC is saturated on this restricted branch.
stress_and_lensing_contract.same_action_lensing_source: The scalar stress sources the Einstein metric and therefore lensing only through the same action; no separate photon multiplier is allowed.
stress_and_lensing_contract.scalar_stress: Tphi_munu=2 p_Xbar nabla_mu(phi)nabla_nu(phi)+2 Mpl^2 a0^2 p g_munu
